rationales.ADBE: Adobe's 89% gross margins and $9.3B FCF at a near 9.5x forward P/E after a -25% six-month drawdown offer asymmetric re-rating potential; Firefly AI monetization accelerating across Creative Cloud provides the near-term catalyst with p=0.57 conviction.

rationales.NEM: Newmont's forward P/E of 9.62 against 78.6% earnings growth, $9.8B FCF, and 25.8% ROE positions it as the premier gold compounder; 3.95% CPI persistence supports gold pricing while the 0.45 beta provides portfolio ballast with p=0.56.
rationales.NBIX: Neurocrine's Ingrezza franchise delivers 19.3% earnings growth and $820M FCF at 16.2x forward P/E with a defensive 0.31 beta; retained in the 7-day catalyst window as pipeline readouts in psychiatry and endocrinology provide additional upside optionality at p=0.54.
rationales.META: META's 33.1% revenue and 62.4% earnings growth at 16.97x forward P/E generating $25.6B FCF represents one of the most compelling risk/reward setups in mega-cap tech; AI-driven ad monetization expanding 32.9% ROE with an attractive entry after the pullback at p=0.58.
rationales.AMG: Affiliated Managers Group trades at 7.77x forward P/E against 122.1% earnings growth with $450M FCF and 19.9% ROE; persistent 6-month momentum confirms the institutional re-rating thesis is intact within the 7-day holding window at p=0.58.
rationales.RRC: Range Resources offers disciplined Appalachian gas production at 9.3x forward P/E with 52.5% gross margins and LNG export tailwinds; the 0.52 beta and strong FCF generation provide portfolio diversification in the Energy sector at p=0.54.
rationales.DUOL: Duolingo's AI-powered language learning platform is compounding revenue at 61% with 73.4% gross margins as paid subscriber monetization accelerates globally; the highest composite score among new picks at p=0.61 conviction with the full 0.055 sizing hint allocated.
rationales.EXEL: Exelixis's cabozantinib franchise generates 96% gross margins, 84% earnings growth, and $1.3B FCF with a defensive 0.42 beta at a compelling 14.3x forward P/E; multi-indication oncology durability and pipeline optionality support the thesis with p=0.61.
rationales.GOOGL: Alphabet's Search, Cloud, and Waymo AI monetization drive 12% revenue and 49% earnings growth at 17.6x forward P/E with $74.5B FCF and a pristine balance sheet; valuation has reset with the recent pullback while the AI infrastructure flywheel compounds at p=0.58.
rationales.THC: Tenet Healthcare trades at 10.64x forward P/E with 87.6% earnings growth, $3.06B FCF, and 30.3% ROE on a $16.3B market cap; FCF-funded balance sheet deleveraging and margin expansion are the twin re-rating catalysts with p=0.58 conviction.
rationales.CPAY: Corpay's B2B payment processing franchise delivers 160bps of expected alpha with 0.58 p_outperform and 0.50 conviction; high gross margins and expanding corporate payment volumes compound durably in the current 3.63% rate environment.
rationales.GMED: Globus Medical's spine robotics platform was purchased 7 days ago and is retained at half-weight (2.8%) to respect the turnover cap; the position will be fully evaluated for rotation at the next rebalance if it remains off the shortlist.
rationales.STZ: Constellation Brands is trimmed to minimum weight (2.0%) as a turnover-cap accommodation rather than a high-conviction hold; the Consumer Defensive sector exposure adds portfolio diversification while the position decays toward next week's evaluation.
